Ka igkarangeb ne baseen te

The second document of

Krunikas

Chronicles

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka Ikarangeb ne Krunikas sumpul te An-anayan ne Krunikas. Nasulat kayi ka pegmandu ni Hari Sulumun, ka pegribildi te me tribu ne diye te igkahibang ne balabahan ki Rihubuwam ne anak ni Hari Sulumun. Ka seeye ne pegribildi impanguluwan ni Hirubuwam. Nasulat man-e kayi ka meyitenged te migharian te Huda wey ka pegkatalu te keet-etawan te Hirusalim te 586 te ware pad neetew si Kristu.

The Second Chronicles is a sequel of First Chronicles. It is written here the ruling of King Sulumun, the rebellion of the tribes there in the north (LIT left side) against_Rihubuwam who was the son of King Sulumun. That rebellion was spearheaded by Hirubuwam. It's written also here concerning the kingdom of Huda and the defeat of Hirusalim in 586 before Christ was_born.

Ka pegbuyu ni Sulumun te katagseb

(1 Hari 3:1‑15)

(1 Kings 3:1‑15)

Purisu, miglibulung diye ensi Sulumun eyew eg-inse te Magbebaye. 6 Ne migpamaneyik si Sulumun diye te altar ne burunsi ne diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne diye te Balungbalung ne Temuwanan, wey migpanubad sikandin te egtutungen ne sabeka ne libu (1,000) ne me ayam.

2 And Sulumun had_ all the (ones) from_Israil _called, the commanders of thousands and hundreds of soldiers, the judges, all the leaders of Israil, and all the leaders of families. 3 And Solomon accompany them all to sacrificing_places at Gibyun because the Tent that's a Meeting_place were there that was_made by Muwisis the servant of the God; the Tent that was_made there in the desert. 4 [xr]At that time, the Container of the Agreement of God had_been_placed into the tent that Dabid prepared there in Hirusalim because he already moved it from Kiryat-Hiyarim. 5 [xr]But the bronze altar that was_made by Bisalil the child of Uri and the grandchild of Hur, (was) still there at Gibyun there in front of the Holy Tent of the Lord. Therefore, Sulumun and_company gathered there in_order to request_help from the Lord. 6 And Sulumun ascended there to the bronze altar there in front of the Lord there at the Tent that's a Meeting_place, and he sacrificed one thousand (1,000) units of domestic_animals to be burnt in fire.

7 Te seeye ne marusilem, migpakita ka Manama ki Sulumun wey migkahi, “Buyu ka ke nekey ka igkeupii nu wey igbehey ku keykew.”

7 On that night, God revealed_(himself) to Sulumun and said, “Request(sg) what (ever) you(sg) desire and I will_give (it) to_you(sg).”

8 Ne migtabak si Sulumun, “Impapitew nu te geyinawa nu ne kene egkabalbalawan ka amey ku ne si Dabid, wey impahari a nikeykew subal kandin. 9 Ne kuntee, he Magbebaye ne Manama, tumana nu ka insaad nu te amey ku su impahari e ma nikeykew te keet-etawan ne iling kasulug te pantad. 10 Behayi a nikeykew te katagseb wey katuenan eyew egkamanduan ku seini ne keet-etawan. 8 And Sulumun answered, “You(sg) showed your(sg) unchangeable love to my father Dabid, and I've been_made_king by_you(sg) replacing him. 9 And now/today, oh Lord God, obey(sg) what_ you(sg) _promised to my father because I've been_made_king by_you(sg) of the people that are_like the numerousness of sand. 10 Give(sg) me wisdom and knowledge in_order_that I can_rule these people. 11 Ne migtabak ka Manama ki Sulumun, “Tenged te migbuyu ka te katagseb wey katuenan eyew egkamanduan nu ka keet-etawan ku ne impaharian ku keykew wey kene ne karatuan, kabantug, wey ke kamatayen naa te me kuntere nu wey ke malayat naa ne umul, 12 igbehey ku keykew ka imbuyu nu ne katagseb wey katuenan. Ne kene ne sikan de, egbehayan ku pad man-e sikeykew te karatuan wey kabantug ne ware naangken te me Hari ne nekewun-a keykew, wey kene man-e egkaangken te egpakasinundul keykew.”

Ka kabantug wey karatuan ni Sulumun

The honor and wealth of Sulumun

(1 Hari 10:26‑29)

(1 Kings 10:26‑29)

13 Nataman, mig-awe e si Sulumun puun te bubungan ne panubaran diye te Gibyun, wey mig-uli e sikandin diye te Hirusalim su diye ma sikandin mig-ugpe te peghari din te Israil. 14 [xr]Ne nakalimud si Sulumun te sabeka ne libu wey hep-at ne gatus (1,400) ne karwahi wey sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) ne kudde.[fn] Impanahu din ka duma diye te me siyudad ne tahuanan te me karwahi rin wey ka duma diye te Hirusalim. 15 Te timpu ne iyan mighari si Sulumun te Israil, egpekeiling naan de te me batu ka me bulawan wey ka pelata diye te Hirusalim tenged te kasulug kayi. Ne ka me kayu degma ne sidar, egpekeiling naan de te me kayu ne sikumuru ne diye te lenlen te me bubungan te Huda[fn] tenged te kasulug kayi. 16 [xr]Egpuun te Ihiptu wey Kui ka me kudde ni Sulumun. Impameli sika te eleg ne kentiddad te me suluhuanen din ne talagbebeli. 17 Te seeye ne timpu ka karwahi ne egpuun te Ihiptu, tighen-em ne gatus (600) ne pelata ka kentiddad te tagse sabeka. Ne 150 ne pelata ka kentiddad te tagse sabeka te me kudde. Ne igpamelegye dan naa degma seeye diye te me Hari te me matig-Hiti wey me matig-Sirya.

13 Then, Sulumun left from the mountain that's a sacrificing_place there at Gibyun, and he returned_home there to Hirusalim because he lived there for his kinging of Israil. 14 [xr]And Sulumun collected one thousand and four hundred (1,400) chariots and twelve thousand (12,000) horses.[fn] He put(pl) some of them there in the cities that's the storage_places for his chariots and some there in Hirusalim. 15 At the time that Sulumun kinged in Israil, gold and silver were_ just _like stones there in Hirusalim due to the numerousness of them. And also cedar trees/wood, were_ just _like sikumuru trees/wood there at the base_slopes of the mountains of Huda[fn] due to the numerousness of them. 16 [xr]The horses of Sulumun were_from(pl) Ihiptu and from Kui. These were_bought(pl) by his traders for the correct price. 17 At that time the cart(s)/chariot(s) from Ihiptu, the price of each one (was) six hundred (600) pieces of silver. And the price of each one horse (was) 150 pieces of silver. And they sold(pl) these also to the kings of the (ones) from_Hiti and of the (ones) from_Sirya.

Ka pegpangandam te pegpasasindeg te timplu

The preparing for building the temple

(1 Hari 5:1‑18)

(1 Kings 5:1‑18)

21 Ne migsuhu si Sulumun ne igpasasindeg ka timplu eyew egkabantug ka Magbebaye ne Manama, wey ka palasyu ne eg-ugpaan din. 2 Ne mig-alam si Sulumun te pitu ne pulu ne libu (70,000) ne me etew ne talaglaglag te me kasangkapan, wey walu ne pulu ne libu (80,000) ne me talagperi te me batu diye te bubungan, wey tatelu ne libu wey hen-em ne gatus (3,600) ne me talagmandu te me trabahanti.

21 And Sulumun commanded that the temple be_built so_that the Lord God will_be_well_known, and the palace that (would) be_ his _living_place. 2 And Sulumun prepared seventy thousand (70,000) people as carriers of equipment, and eighty thousand (80,000) splitters of stones there in the mountain(s), and three thousand and six hundred (3,600) rulers of the workers.

3 Ne migpeuyan si Sulumun te sulat diye ki Hiram ne Hari te Tiru: “Peuyani a te me kayu ne sidar iling te pegpeuyan nu te me sidar ki Dabid ne amey ku te pegpasasindeg din te palasyu rin. 4 Ne kuntee, egpasasindeg a te timplu eyew egkabantug ka Magbebaye ku. Ne ighalad ku seini kandin eyew diye key e egtutung te me meemut ne insinsu, wey diye key e eg-uyan te ighalad ne paan te aldew-aldew. Ne diye key e man-e egpanubad te egtutungen ne igpanubad tagse maselem wey marusilem, te me Aldew te Peggimeley, te me sahakeen te iyam ne bulan, wey te duma pad ne me aldew te pegsahakeen ne intahahe te Magbebaye ne Manama ney. Migsuhu ka Magbebaye ne seini ka eggimuwen te me matig-Israil te ware egtamanan. 5 Dakel amana ka timplu ne igpasasindeg ku, su subla ma ne maresen ka Manama ney du te langun ne me manama. 6 [xr]Piru hentew naa ka egpakapasasindeg te timplu para te Magbebaye? Ne minsan ka langit ne titikangi kene ma ne eleg ne eg-ugpaan din. Ne hentew e naan de iya degma se egpasasindeg te timplu para kandin, angin e ke tutunganan de te insinsu diye te tangkaan din. 7 Sikan naa, peuyani a te etew ne mangngateu ne eggimu te me kasangkapan puun te bulawan, pelata, burunsi, putew wey mangngateu ne egpangabel te bula-bula ne malugtem, malalab, wey meilem. Keilangan ne mangngateu sikandin ne egkulit, wey egtrabahu sikandin duma te me mangngateu ne etew ne matig-Huda wey matig-Hirusalim, ne tapey e alama te amey ku ne si Dabid. 8 Peuyani a man-e te me kayu ne sidar, sipris wey algum puun te Libanun, su nakanengneng a ne mangngateu ka me suluhuanen nu ne egpameled te kayu. Ne egsuhuen ku ka me suluhuanen ku eyew egbulig te me suluhuanen nu 9 ne eg-andam te masulug ne kayu para te timplu ne igpasasindeg ku su tetelesi ma seini wey luluahi. 10 Egbayaran ku ka me suluhuanen nu ne egpameled te me kayu te sabeka ne gatus ne libu (100,000) ne saku ne harina, sabeka ne gatus ne libu (100,000) ne saku ne trigu, sabeka ne gatus wey sapulu ne libu (110,000) ne gelun ne binu, wey sabeka ne gatus wey sapulu ne libu ne gatus (110,000) ne gelun ne lana te ulibu.”

And there we(excl) will_ also _sacrifice burnt offering that will_be_a_sacrifice each morning and night/evening, on the Days of Resting, at the feasts of the new moon, and for other days of feasting that have_been_prepared by the Lord our(excl) God. And even the very_high sky/heaven isn't correct for his living_place. It's_necessary that he (is) very_skilled at sculpting, and he will_work along_with very_skilled people from_Huda and from_Hirusalim, chosen before by my father Dabid. 8 Send me also cedar trees/wood, cypress and algum from Libanun, because I know that your(sg) servants (are) very_skilled at felling(pl) tree(s). And I will_command my servants to_help your(sg) servants 9 to_prepare many trees for the temple that I'm building because this (is) very_beautiful and very_wide. 10 I will_pay your(sg) servants that fell(pl) trees one hundred thousand (100,000) sacks of flour, one hundred thousand (100,000) sacks of wheat, one hundred ten thousand (110,000) gallon_containers of wine, and one hundred ten thousand (110,000) gallon_containers of olive oil.”

11 Ne seini ka tabak ni Hiram ne Hari te Tiru te sulat ni Sulumun: “Tenged te geyinawa te Magbebaye te keet-etawan din, impahari ka nikandin kandan.” 12 Ne migkahi pad man-e si Hiram, “Egdayanen ka Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil, ne miggimu te langit wey tane! 11 And this (was) the answer by Hiram the king of Tiru to the letter by Sulumun: “Due to the love of the Lord for his people, you(sg) have_been_made_king of_them by_him.” 12 Hiram also said, “(May) the Lord, the God of Israil be_praised, that made the heaven and land! Mangngateu man-e sikandin ne egpangulit te minsan nekey ne igpeyimu nu kandin. Ne egtrabahu sikandin duma te trabahanti nu wey te me trabahanti ne tapey e alama te amey nu ne si Dabid. 15 Purisu, talahuren ne Sulumun, ipeuyan nu te me suluhuanen nu ka ingkahi nu ne trigu, sibada, lana te ulibu, wey binu, 16 su egpameled key te me kayu diye te Libanun sumale te egkeilanganen nu. Ne iglawang ney re seini diye te dahat taman te Hupa, wey sikaniyud e ka eg-uyan kayi diye te Hirusalim.”

13 “I will_send_ Huram-Abi[fn] the very_skilled and wise worker _there. 14 His mother (is/was) a descendant of Dan and his father (is/was) from_Tiru. He (is) very_skilled at making(pl) furniture/utensils from gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone and wood, and at making expensive woven_cloth that's purple, blue/green, and red. He's also very_skilled at sculpting what ever that you(sg) get_ him _to_do. And he will_work along_with your(sg) workers and the workers that were_chosen before by your(sg) father Dabid. 15 Therefore, honored Sulumun, send(sg) the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine that_ you(sg) _said with your(sg) servants, 16 because we(excl) will_fell(pl) trees here in Libanun according to what_ you(sg) _need. And we(excl) will_ just _raft it there in the sea until Hupa, and then you(pl) will_bring it to Hirusalim.”

Ka pegbunsud te pegpasasindeg te timplu

The beginning building the temple

(1 Hari 6:1‑38)

(1 Kings 6:1‑38)

17 Ne impasinsus ni Sulumun ka langun ne lapu te Israil iling te inggimu te amey rin ne si Dabid wey nanengnengan din ne 153,600 sikandan langun. 18 Ne pitu ne pulu ne libu (70,000) kandan ka me talaglaglag te me kasangkapan te pegbebaley wey ka walu ne pulu ne libu (80,000) kandan ka me talagperi te me batu diye te bubungan, wey ka tatelu ne libu wey hen-em ne gatus (3,600) kandan ka me talagmandu te me trabahanti.

31 [xr]Nataman, imbunsuran e ni Sulumun ka pegpasasindeg te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te Hirusalim, diye te Bubungan ne Muriya, ka bubungan ne migpakita ka Magbebaye ki Dabid ne amey rin. Diye din seini ipasasindeg te natahuan te diekanan ni Arawuna[fn] ne Hibusihanen, sumale te ingkahi kandin ni Dabid. 2 Migbunsud sikandin migpasasindeg te timplu te igkarangeb ne aldew te igkarangeb ne bulan, te igkeep-at ne leg-un te peghari din. 3 Ne ka kalayat te pabunsuran te timplu te Manama daruwa ne pulu wey pitu (27) ne mitrus wey ka kaluag siyam ne mitrus. Inseked seini pinaahi te tapey ne sekeranan. 4 Ne siyam ne mitrus ka kaluag te likansu diye te katangkaan te timplu iling kaluag te timplu. Ne tatelu ne pulu (30) ne pala-pala degma ka katikang kayi. Ne impulitan din ka seled kayi te neelin ne bulawan. 5 Ne ka diye te seled te timplu impaalabatan din te kayu ne sipris wey impapulitan din te neelin ne bulawan wey ingkulitan seini te me palmira wey me keddina. 6 Ne imparayan-dayanan din seini te mahal ne batu wey te bulawan ne egpuun pad te Parbaim. 7 Ne impapulitan din te bulawan ka intiru ne timplu—ka me lilliyungan, me sungkaleg te lekeb, me alabat, wey ka me gumawan. Ne impakulitan din te me kirubin[fn] ka me alabat.

31 [xr]Then, Sulumun began getting_ the temple of the Lord God _built there in Hirusalim, there on the Mount Muriya, the mountain where the Lord revealed_(himself) to Dabid his father. This was_built there at the place_where the treading_place of Arawuna[fn] the Hibusihanon, according to what_ Dabid _told him. 2 He began building the temple on the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his kinging. 3 And the length of the foundation of the temple of God (was) twenty and seven (27) meters and the width (was) nine meters. This was_measured by_means of the old measuring_device. 4 And the width of the porch there in front of the temple (was) nine meters like the width of the temple. And the height of it (was) also thirty (30) feet. And he plastered the inside of it with pure/genuine gold. 5 And the inside of the temple he had_walled with cypress wood and he had_(it)_plastered with pure gold and this was_sculpted with palms and chains. 6 And he had_ this _decorated with expensive stones and with gold from Parbaim. 7 And he_had the entire temple plastered with gold—the ridges, posts of doors, walls, and doorways. And he had_ the walls _sculpted with cherubim(s).[fn]

8 [xr]Ne inggimu rin ka Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng ne siyam ne mitrus ka katikang wey siyam ne mitrus ka kaluag. Impapulitan din seini te neelin ne bulawan ne daruwa ne pulu wey sabeka ne libu (21,000) ne kilu. 9 Me bulawan degma ka me lansang ne inggamit ne tigliware te kilu ka kabehat. Impapulitan din degma te bulawan ka me alabat te sinabeng diye te dibabew.

8 [xr]And he made the Very Holy Room and its height (was) nine meters and its width (was) nine meters. He caused_it_to_be_plastered(pl) with pure gold that (was) twenty one thousand (21,000) kilograms. 9 The nails that were_used (were) also gold(pl) and each_half a kilogram in weight. He also had_ the walls of the room there above _covered with gold.

10 [xr]Ne ka diye te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng, impeyimuwan din te daruwa ne kirubin wey impapulitan din seini te bulawan. 11 Ne ka kalayat te daruwa ne pakpak te kirubin ne nabekal, siyam ne mitrus. Ne ka tagse pulipusan te pakpak nekeuma diye te alabat, 12 wey nekegtupu ka me pakpak diye te elat, wey subla te daruwa ne mitrus ka tagse pakpak. 13 Impasasindeg ka me kirubin wey diye impatangke te likansu te timplu. 14 [xr]Ne ka kurtina ne in-elet diye te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng, inggimu puun te linu ne meilem, malugtem, wey malalab-lalab, wey inteyian seini te larawan te me kirubin.

10 [xr]And there in the Very Holy Room, he had_ two cherubim _made and he had_ them _covered with gold. 11 And the length of the two wings of cherubim being spread, was nine meters. And each end_point of the wing reached at the wall, 12 and the wings joint_together in the middle, and each wing (is) more than two meters. 13 The cherubims were stood_up and caused_to_face_up the nave of the temple. 14 [xr]And the curtain that's covering the Very Holy Room, was_made from blue linen, dark_red, and reddish, and it was tailored with the image of a cherubim(s).

Ka daruwa ne sungkaleg ne burunsi

The two bronze posts

(1 Hari 7:15‑22)

(1 Kings 7:15‑22)

15 Ne migpeyimu man-e si Sulumun te daruwa ne sungkaleg diye te tangkaan te timplu ne subla te sabeka ne pulu wey lalimma (15) ne mitrus ka kalayat. Ne ka tagse sungkaleg due ulu-ulu ne subla te daruwa ne mitrus ka kalayat. 16 Ne migpeyimu man-e si Sulumun te me keddina ne egpekeiling te me balieg wey insanggat din seini diye te me pupul te me sungkaleg. Migpeyimu man-e sikandin te sabeka ne gatus (100) ne me prutas ne egngaranan te granada puun te burunsi wey impamitin din seini diye te me keddina. 17 Ne impasasindeg din ka me sungkaleg diye te tangkaan te timplu, ka sabeka diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan, wey ka sabeka diye te igkahibang ne balabahan. Ne ka diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan, ingngaranan te Hakin, ne ka diye te igkahibang ne balabahan, ingngaranan te Buas.

15 And Sulumun also caused_(others)_to_make two posts in front of the temple with a length of more than fifteen (15) meters. And each post had head_point with a length exceeding two meters. 16 And Sulumun also caused_others_to_make chains like the necklaces and he hooked_it_up there at the edge of the posts. He also caused_others_to_make one hundred (100) fruits named granada and he hanged it there in the chains. 17 And he caused_ the posts _to_stand_erect there in the front of the temple, one was in the south (LIT right side), and the other was in the north (LIT left side). And the one in the south, was called Hakin, and the other in the north (LIT left side), was called Buas.

Ka me kasangkapan te timplu

The utensils of the temple

(1 Hari 7:23‑51)

(1 Kings 7:23‑51)

41 [xr]Ne migpeyimu si Sulumun te altar ne burunsi ne siyam ne mitrus ka kalayat wey siyam degma ne mitrus ka kaluag wey hep-at wey tenge ne mitrus ka katikang. 2 Ne migpeyimu man-e sikandin te bubuyahen ne pelenggana ne burunsi ne egtahuan te weyig ne egngaranan te Dahat. Subla te hep-at ne mitrus ka kaluag wey subla te daruwa ne mitrus ka katikang, wey subla te sapulu wey tatelu (13) ne mitrus ka kalibusen. 3 Ne diye te diddiralem te bibig te pelenggana, inlingutan dayan-dayani te daruwa ne dangdang te egpekeiling te me turu ne baka ne impareket. Me daruwa ne pulu (20) ne baka ka impareket te tagse mitrus. 4 Impapinnuu ka bubuyahen ne pelenggana ne burunsi diye te peka te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne immangimu ne baka ne immeg-inniyug: tatelu ka nakatangke diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan, tatelu ka nakatangke diye te igkahibang ne balabahan, tatelu ka nakatangke diye te iglineb, wey tatelu ka nakatangke diye te igsile. 5 Sengerangew ka kakepal te bibig te limuranan te weyig ne iling te bibig te ubag ne nekeiling te bulak ne liryu ne migpamukadkad. Egkatahuan seini te me sapulu wey walu ne libu (18,000) ne gelun ne weyig. 6 [xr]Ne migpeyimu man-e si Sulumun te sapulu (10) ne pelenggana ne lu-luanan te igmanubad ne egtutungen. Impanahu din ka lalimma diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan wey ka lalimma diye te igkahibang ne balabahan. Ne ka weyig diye te bubuyahen ne pelenggana iyan igpanlu-lu te me talagpanubad.

41 [xr]And Sulumun also caused_others_to_make a bronze altar that's nine meters long and also nine wide and four and half meters high. 2 And he caused_others_to_make a big bronze basin to put_in a water that's called Sea. More than four meters its width and more than two meters its height, and more than thirteen (13) meters its circumference. 3 And there below the lip of the basin, encircled with the two lines of looks_like of bulls that's attached. About twenty (20) bulls that's attached every meter. 4 The very_big basin was caused_to_sit on the twelve (12) made bulls of bronze which were facing_opposite_each_other: three were facing there in the south (LIT right side of east), three were facing there in the north (LIT left side of east), three were facing there in the west, and three were facing the east. 5 The thickness of the lip of the container of water is one span that's like the lip of a cup like a liryu flower that bloomed. It can contain about eighteen thousand (18,000) gallons of water. 6 [xr]And also Sulumun caused_others_to_make ten (10) basins for washing_purposes of the sacrifices to be burned. He put five there in the south and the (other) five were in the north. And the water there in the very_big basin was the thing_used_to_wash by the sacrificer.

7 [xr]Ne migpeyimu si Sulumun te sapulu (10) ne bulawan ne tahuanan te sulu sumale te implanu. Ne intahu seini diye te timplu: lalimma ka diye te igkakawanan, wey lalimma degma ka diye te igkahibang. 8 [xr]Migpeyimu pad man-e sikandin te sapulu (10) ne lamisa wey intahu seini diye te timplu, lalimma ka diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan wey lalimma degma ka diye te igkahibang ne balabahan. Ne migpeyimu pad man-e sikandin te sabeka ne gatus (100) ne yahung ne bulawan.

7 [xr]And Sulumun caused_others_to_make ten (10) gold container of lamp according to what_was_planned. And it was put there in the temple: five were in the right_side, five were also there in the left. 8 [xr]He caused_others_to_make also ten (10) tables and put them in the temple, five were in the north and five also were in the south. And he caused_others_to_make also one hundred (100) gold bowls.

9 Ne inlamaan din ka timplu te maluag para te me talagpanubad wey duen pad man-e malmaluag ne lama diye te lihawangan. Ne in-alad din ka me lama wey impeyimuwan din te me gumawan ne impamulitan te burunsi. 10 Ne intahu din ka bubuyahen ne pelenggana ne egngaranan te Dahat diye te marani te elat-elat te igkakawanan ne balabahan wey dapit te igsile ne pikungan te timplu.

9 He made_the_yard of the temple wide for the sacrificers and there_is still wider yard there outside. And he fenced the yard and he caused_ (others) _to_make doors that's covered with bronze. 10 And he put the very_big basin which is called Sea near the middle of the south and east side of the corner of the temple.

11 Miggimu degma si Huram-Abi te kuren, me pala, wey me yahung ne eggamiten te pegpabesik.

11 Huram-Abi also made pots, shovels, bowls used for splashing.

Neimpusan ded iya ni Huram-Abi ka langun ne impeyimu ni Sulumun te timplu te Manama. Seini ka immangimu rin:12 ka daruwa ne sungkaleg; ka daruwa ne pupul te me sungkaleg ne egpekeiling te yahung; ka daruwa ne inlubid ne keddina ne indayan-dayan diye te pupul te me sungkaleg; 13 ka hep-at ne gatus (400) ne me prutas ne egngaranan te granada ne burunsi ne impamitin te daruwa ne dangdang diye te inlubid ne keddina ne intahu diye te pupul te me sungkaleg; 14 ka me peunturan wey ka me pelenggana ne igmapinnuu; 15 ka tahuanan te weyig ne egngaranan te Dahat wey ka sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne larawan te turu ne baka ne egpeunturan kayi; 16 ka me kuren ne inggimu puun te tane, ka me pala, wey ka derakel ne tinidur.

Huram-Abi indeed completed all that Sulumun asked for the temple of God. These were the things_ he _made:12 two posts; two end_points of the posts like the bowls; two intertwined chains decorated at the end_point of the posts; 13 the four hundred (400) bronze like the pomegranate fruits hanged on the two lines there on the intertwined chains that were put at the end_point of the posts; 14 the bases and the basins caused_to_be_seated; 15 the water container that's called Sea and twelve (12) statues of male cow that were_the_mounting_place of it; 16 pots made from soil, shovels, and big(pl) fork(s).

Impasinawan ka langun ne kasangkapan ne burunsi ne impeyimu ni Hari Sulumun ki Huram para te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama.

All the materials that bronze were_made_shiny that King Sulumun caused_to_be_made by Huram for the temple of the Lord God.

17 The king caused_it_to_be_made there in the valley of Hurdan where pots made of soil were_made there at the boundary of Sukut and Sirida. 18 Many bronze were used by Sulumun, that's why (it) wasn't found out how many kilos of all bronze that's used.

19 Ne migpeyimu man-e si Sulumun te seini ne me kasangkapan para te timplu te Manama: ka bulawan ne altar ne eg-unturan te egtutungen; ka me lamisa ne eg-unturan te paan ne ighalad diye te tangkaan te Manama; 20 ka me tahuanan te sulu ne neelin ne bulawan wey ka me sulu kayi ne iyan igteng-ew diye te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng sumale te implanu; 21 ka indayan-dayan ne neneelin ne bulawan ne me bulak, me sulu, wey me sipit; 22 ka igmanempug te pebilu te sulu, ka me pelenggana, ka me tahuanan te insinsu, ka me tahuanan te baha ne neneelin ne bulawan. Ka me gumawan te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng, wey ka me gumawan diye te lama te timplu ne impamulitan te bulawan.

19 And Sulumun also caused_to_make utensils for the temple of God: the gold altar to put_on a burning_offering; the tables to put_on the bread to offer there in front of God; 20 the containers/holders of lamp(s) that were pure gold and its lamps which gave_light there in the Very Holy Room according to what_was_planned; 21 the pure gold flowers, lamps, and clips made_as_decorations; 22 the cutters of the wick of the lamp, the basins, the containers of incense, the containers of embers which were pure gold. The gates of doorway of the Very Holy Room, and the gates of the doorway of the courtyard of the temple which were covered with gold.

2 [xr]Ne impeumew ni Hari Sulumun diye te Hirusalim ka me pangulu te me matig-Israil, ka me pangulu te kabuhalan, wey ka me pangulu te me pamilya eyew eg-uyan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye ne Manama puun te Siyudad ni Dabid ne iyan ka Hirusalim.[fn] 3 Purisu, nanlibulung e sikandan langun diye te tangkaan ni Hari Sulumun, te timpu te Sahakeen te me Balungbalung te igkapitu ne bulan. 4 Te nalibulung e ka me pangulu te me matig-Israil, intitiang e te me talagpanubad wey te me Libita ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan, 5 wey in-uuyan dan e diye te timplu. Ne in-uuyan dan degma ka Balungbalung ne Temuwanan wey ka matulus ne me kasangkapan te timplu. 6 Ne si Hari Sulumun wey ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil ne miglibulung diye te tangkaan te Tahuanan te Kasabutan, migpanubad te susuluhi amana ne karniru wey me baka ne kenad e egkaseel. 7 Ne in-uyan e te me talagpanubad ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye diye te ledled te matulus ne baley, diye te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng te timplu. Ne intahu dan e seini diye te diralem te nekegtupu ne impabekal ne me pakpak te daruwa ne kirubin. 8 Impabekal ka me pakpak te daruwa ne kirubin, sikan naa ka natel-eban kayi ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan lagkes ka me yayunganan. 9 Mallayat ka me yayunganan wey nakatimpa seini te Amana ne Matulus ne Sinabeng. Piru kene de iya man-e seini egkiteen diye te lihawangan. Ne diye ded iya seini taman kuntee. 10 [xr]Ware lein ne tahu te Tahuanan te Kasabutan angin e te daruwa ne malumpayag ne me batu ne intahu ni Muwisis te diye sikandin te bubungan ne Sinay[fn] ka inged ne miggimu ka Magbebaye te kasabutan te me matig-Israil te peglihawang dan te Ihiptu.

2 [xr]And Sulumun summoned there in Hirusalim the leaders of the (ones) from_Israil, the leaders of the descendants, the leaders of the families in_order to bring the Container of the Lord God from the City of Dabid which was Siyun.[fn] 3 Therefore, all of them gathered together there in the front of king Sulumun, at the time of the Feast of the Tents on the seventh month. 4 When the leaders of Israil were gathered together, the sacrificers and the Libitas carried_on_shoulder the Container of the Agreement, 5 and brought (it) there in the temple. They also brought the Tent of Meeting and the holy utensils of the temple. 6 And king Sulumun and all the descendants of Israil that gathered there in front of the Container of the Agreement, sacrificed very many sheep and cows that couldn't be_counted. 7 And the sacrificers brought the Container of the Covenant of the Lord God there in the inner_part of the holy house, there in the Very Holy Room of the temple. And they kept it there under the joint wings of the two cherubims spreading_over. 8 The wings of the two cherubims were caused_to_spread_over, that's why the Container of the Agreement including the carrying_poles were under its shed. 9 The carrying_poles were long and extend_beyond the Very Holy Room. But it not also be seen from the outside. And this was still there until now/today. 10 [xr]Nothing else was inside the Container of the Agreement except two flat stones that Muwisis put in when he was at the mountain of Sinay[fn] the place where the Lord made an agreement with the (ones) from_Israil on their coming_out of Ihiptu.

Ka kabantug te Magbebaye

The fame of the Lord

11 Pegkapenga dutu, nanlihawang e ka me talagpanubad puun te Matulus ne Sinabeng. Ne miglinis te pegkeetew ran ka langun ne me talagpanubad ne diye, minsan ke timpu ran te pegpamakey wey se kene. 12 Ne ka me Libita ne me mangngulahing ne si Asap, si Himan, si Hidutun, wey ka me anak dan wey ka me karumaan dan, migmanasindeg diye te lenged te altar dapit te igsile. Migsaluub sikandan te mahal ne hinabel wey migparahing te me putew ne basalan, te me alpa, wey te me lira. Ne migparahing degma te igbales ne me trumpita ka sabeka ne gatus wey daruwa ne pulu (120) ne me talagpanubad. 13 [xr][xr]Ne iyan katungdanan te me talagparahing te trumpita wey te me mangngulahing, ka pegsabeka te pegdayan wey pegpasalamat diye te Magbebaye. Ne mig-ulahing e sikandan ne imbalesan te me trumpita, te putew ne basalan, wey te duma pad ne instrumintu ne eggamiten te pegdayan. Ne seini ka ulahingen dan:

11 After that, the sacrificers came_out(pl) from the Holy Room. And all the sacrificers cleaned themselves there, even if (it was) the time of their serving or not. 12 And Libita singers such as Asap, Himan, Hidutun, and their children and their relatives, stood there near the altar at the east side. They wore an expensive cloths and made_a_sound_out of the iron cymbals (LIT beating instrument), harps, and lyres. And the one hundred twenty (120) sacrificers also sounded the trumpets to match_beat with them. 13 [xr][xr]And the responsibility of the ones_sounding trumpets and the singers, (was) uniting in praising and giving_thanks there to the Lord. And they sang and matched_beat with trumpets, iron cymbals, and other instruments used for praising. And this was their song:

“Meupiya ka Magbebaye;

“The Lord (is) good;

kene egkabalbalawan ka geyinawa rin.”

his love is unchangeable.”

Ne due gapun ne mig-empet te timplu te Magbebaye.14 Purisu, warad nakapabulus ka himu te me talagpanubad diye te timplu tenged te gapun, su napenu ma te katelesan te Magbebaye ka timplu rin.

And there was cloud that covered the temple of the Lord.14 Therefore, the work of the sacrificers did_ not _continue in the temple due to the cloud, for the splendor of the Lord filled his temple.

13 Ne ka me talagpanubad wey ka me Libita ne mig-ugpe diye te nalein-lein ne inged te Israil miggendiye ki Rihubuwam. 14 In-engkeran te me Libita ka tane dan wey karatuan dan wey miggendiye sikandan te Huda wey te Hirusalim tenged su ingkenaan man e sikandan ni Hirubuwam wey te me anak din ne egpamakey te Magbebaye isip me talagpanubad. 15 [xr]Ne mig-alam si Hirubuwam te me talagpanubad din eyew egpamakey diye te me panubaran diye te me bubungan wey egpangulu te pegsimba te kambing ne me diyus-diyus wey te baka ne me diyus-diyus ne impeyimu rin. 16 Ne ka me matig-Israil ne migpuun te duma ne tribu te Israil ne egkeupian ne egpabulus egpamakey te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil, migsundul te Libita diye te Hirusalim eyew egpanubad diye te Magbebaye, ka Manama te kaap-apuan dan. 17 Nakalig-en sikandan te migharian te Huda wey nakabulig te peghari ni Rihubuwam ne anak ni Sulumun te tatelu ne leg-un su intuman dan ma ka Manama, iling te me timpu te peghari ni Dabid wey ni Sulumun.

13 And the sacrificers and the Libitas who lived there in various places of Israil went to Rihubuwam. 14 The Libitas left their land and their wealth and they went to Huda and Hirusalim because Hirubuwam and his children prohibited them to serve the Lord as sacrificers. 15 [xr]And Hirubuwam chose his sacrificers in_order to serve there in the sacrificing_place there in the mountains and who_led in worshiping the goat gods and cow gods that he caused_others_to_make. 16 And the (ones) from_Israil that came_from other tribes of Israil who desired to continue to worship the Lord, the God of Israil, followed_after the Libitas there in Hirusalim in_order to sacrifice to the Lord, the God of their ancestors. 17 They strengthened the kingdom of Huda and helped the kinging by Rihubuwam the child of Sulumun for three years because they have obeyed God, like the times of Dabid and Sulumun's kinging.

Ka pamilya ni Rihubuwam

The family of Rihubuwam

18 Ne mig-asawa si Rihubuwam ki Mahalat ne anak ni Hirimut. Ka amey ni Hirimut iyan si Dabid wey ka iney rin iyan si Abihail ne anak ni Ilyab ne anak ni Hisi. 19 Ne mig-anak si Mahalat te me lukes ne si Hiyus, si Simariyas wey si Saham. 20 Nataman, mig-asawe e man-e si Rihubuwam ki Maaka ne anak ni Absalum. Ne nakaanak sikandin ki Abiyas, ki Itay, ki Sisa, wey ki Silumit. 21 Inggeyinawaan ni Rihubuwam si Maaka ne anak ni Absalum du te langun ne me asawa rin. Due sapulu wey walu (18) ne asawa rin wey hen-em ne pulu (60) ne me duwey rin. Ne daruwa ne pulu wey walu (28) ka anak din ne me lukes wey hen-em ne pulu (60) ka anak din ne malitan. 22 Ne in-alam ni Rihubuwam si Abiyas ne anak dan ki Maaka isip labew te me anak din su igkeupii rin ne sikandin ka egkeyimu ne Hari. 23 Mig-ay-ayaran ni Rihubuwam te egpamehey te me katungdanan ka me anak din wey intalagtag din sikandan diye te me siyudad te Huda wey te Binhamin ne in-alad te matikang wey makepal ne batu. Impamehayan din sikandan te langun ne ingkeilangan dan, wey impamitawan din sikandan te me malitan ne igmaasawa kandan.

18 And Rihubuwam married Mahalat the child of Hirimut. The father of Hirimut was Dabid and his mother was Abihail the child of Ilyab the child of Hisi. 19 And Mahalat gave_birth to the sons who were Hiyus, Simariyas and Saham. 20 Then, Rihubuwam married again with Maaka child of Absalum. And she gave_birth to Abiyas, Itay, Sisa, and Silumit. 21 Rihubuwam loved Maaka the child of Absalum than all of his spouses. He had eighteen (18) spouses and sixty (60) second_spouses. And he had twenty-eight (28) male children and sixty (60) female children. 22 And Rihubuwam chose Abiyas his child of Maaka as prominent of his children because he desired him to become king. 23 Rihubuwam had given properly his children with responsibilities/roles and he spread them there in the cities of Huda and Binhamin which were fenced with high and thick stones. He has_given them all with their needs, and he looked for women for them to marry.

9 [xr]Purisu, inlusuran iya ni Sisak ka Hirusalim. Impanguwa rin ka me karatuan diye te timplu te Magbebaye wey te palasyu te Hari. 141 Ne migpatey e si Abiyas wey insabal diye te Siyudad ni Dabid. Ka pegbubunu te matig-Itiyupiya

The fighting/attacking of the (ones) from_Itiyupiya

9 Nataman, inlusuran sikandan ni Sira ne matig-Itiyupiya[fn] duma te libu-libu ne me sundalu wey tatelu ne gatus (300) ne me karwahi. Ne nekeuma sikandan diye te inged te Marisa. 10 Ne insinug-ung sikandan enni Asa eyew egbubunu kandan. Migkahi sikandin, “He Magbebaye, warad lein ne egpakabulig te etew ne luyeg ne egkuntere te mannekal ne etew, ke kene sikeykew re. Bulihi key Magbebaye, ne Manama ney, su migsuladlad key ma keykew. Ne miggendini key eyew egbubunu te seini se susuluhi ne sundalu pinaahi te ngaran nu. He Magbebaye, sikeykew ka Manama ney, kene nu tuhuti ne egkatalu ka te etew.”

9 Then, Sira from_Itiyupiya[fn] with thousands of thousands soldiers and three hundred (300) chariots attacked them. Imbehayan dan sikandan te igsaluub, sandal, egkakeen, egkeinum, wey imbawian dan ka me pali dan. 12 And there were leaders of Israil who were Asariyas the child of Diyuhanan, Birikiyas the child of Misilimut, Hihiskiya the child of Salum and Amasa the child of Hadlay who rebuked also those who were went_to_fight. 13 And the said, “Don't bring here the ones_ you(pl) _captured! Do you(pl) want our(incl) sin to the Lord will_increase? Our(incl) sin is already big and the anger of the Lord against Israil is already smoking.” 14 Therefore, the soldiers that each_of_them with weapons left the ones_ they _captured and the things_ they _snatched_away in the front of the leaders and all the people. 15 And those four leaders drew_near to those captured and they gave those naked with clothing from their materials that soldiers have snatched_away. They gave them clothing, sandals, food, drink, and they put_medicines on their wounds. They put the weak on donkeys and caused_ them _to_return in their towns in Hiriku, the city of the palm trees. And those leaders returned there to Samarya.

16-17 Te seeye ne timpu, migpepangabang si Hari Ahas te Hari te Asirya su inlusuran e man-e te me matig-Idum ka Huda wey natalu iya ka Huda, wey impandakep ka duma ne mahinged diye. 18 Te seeye ded ne timpu, inlusuran degma te me Pilistihanen ka me lungsud ne diye te lenlen te me bubungan te Huda[fn] wey ka diye te igkakawanan ne balabahan. Naahew ran ka Bit-Simis, Ayalun, Gidirut, Suku, Timna wey Gimsu lagkes ka me bariyu ne nakalingut diye. 19 Impatalu te Magbebaye ka Huda su intuhutan ma ni Hari Ahas ka keet-etawan din ne eggimu te sale wey warad iya migtuman te Magbebaye. 20 Purisu te pegginguma ni Tiglatpilisir ne Hari te Asirya, nasi din mule baybayari si Ahas. 21 Seeye naa ka migpanguwa si Ahas te me karatuan ne diye te timplu te Magbebaye, diye te palasyu, wey diye te me baley te me upisyal wey imbehey rin seini diye te Hari te Asirya. Piru ware seini nakabulig kandin.

16-17 At that time, king Ahas asked_help from the king of Asirya because Huda is attacked again the (ones) from_Idum and they have defeated Huda, and they captured some of the inhabitants there. 18 At that time also, the Pilistihanons attacked also the cities there in the foot of the mountains of Huda[fn] and those in the south (LIT right side). They captured Bit-Simis, Ayalun, Gidirut, Suku, Timna and Gimsu including the villages around it. 19 The Lord caused_ Huda _to_be_defeated because king Ahas was allowed his people to do sin and did not obey the Lord. 20 Therefore when Tiglatpilisir the king of Asirya arrived, on the contrary he persecuted Ahas instead of helping_him. 21 So then Ahas took some wealth there in the temple of the Lord, there in the palace, and there in the houses of his officers and gave it to the king of Asirya. But it was not help him.

Ka sale ni Ahas

The sin of Ahas

22 Ne neulat de iya ne ware migmatinumanen si Ahas te Magbebaye te neyirapan e sikandin. 23 Migpanubad sikandin diye te me diyus-diyus te Damasku ne nakatalu kandin. Su migkahi sikandin, “Migbulihan te seini ne me manama ka Hari te Sirya. Purisu, egpanubad a te seini ne me manama eyew egbulihan a nikandan.” Piru seeye ka nakarereet kandin wey te Israil. 24 Ne impanguwa ni Ahas ka me kasangkapan te timplu te Manama wey impanlupet din seini. Inlekeban din ka timplu wey migpasasindeg sikandin te me altar diye te tagse pikungan diye te Hirusalim. 25 Ne migpasasindeg man-e sikandin te me panubaran diye te me bubungan te langun ne lungsud te Huda eyew diye egpanubad te me diyus-diyus. Purisu nalangetan kandin ka Magbebaye, ka Manama te me kaap-apuan dan.

22 And Ahas became not faithful even_more to the Lord when he suffered. 23 He sacrificed_animals to the false_gods there in Damasku that defeated him. Because he said, “These gods helped the king of Sirya. Therefore, I will_sacrifice_animals so_that I will_be_helped by it.” But it was the thing that destroyed him and of Israil. 24 And Ahas took the utensils in the temple of God and he smashed them. He closed the temple and he erected altars there on each corner there in Hirusalim. 25 And he also erected also sacrificial_places there in the mountains of all the towns of Huda in_order to sacrifice there to the false_gods. Therefore the Lord, the God of their ancestors was_very_angry at him.

26 Ne ka duma pad ne guhuren meyitenged te peghari ni Ahas wey te me hinimuwan din puun te an-anayan taman te katamanan, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Huda wey Israil. 27 [xr]Ne migpatey si Ahas wey diye sikandin isabal te siyudad te Hirusalim, piru kene ne diye te sulung ne sabalanan te me Hari te Israil. Ne si Isikiyas e ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari.

26 And the rest stories concerning the kinging by Ahas and his deeds from the beginning until the end, were written there in the Writing_document of the of the Stories of the kings of Huda and Israil. 27 [xr]And Ahas died and he was_wrapped_and_stored in the city of Hirusalim, but not there in the cave that burial_storage_places of the kings of Israil. And his child Isikiyas was the (one who) replaced him in reigning.

Ka peglinis te timplu

The cleaning of the temple

(2 Hari 18:1‑3)

(2 Kings 18:1‑3)

291 Daruwa ne pulu wey lalimma (25) ka idad ni Isikiyas te neyimu sikandin ne Hari, wey mighari sikandin diye te Hirusalim te daruwa ne pulu wey siyam (29) ne leg-un. Si Abiha ne anak ni Sakariyas ka iney rin. 2 Meupiya ka hinimuwan din diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama iling te hinimuwan te kaapuan din ne si Dabid.

291 The age of Isikiyas was twenty-five (25) when he became king, and he reigned there in Hirusalim for twenty-nine (29) years. Abiha the child of Sakariyas was his mother. 2 His deed was good there in front of the Lord God like what_ Dabid his ancestor _did.

3 Te an-anayan ne bulan te an-anayan ne leg-un te peghari din, impalukatan din e man-e ka timplu te Magbebaye wey impaay-ayaran din seini. 4 Inlibulung din ka me talagpanubad wey ka me Libita diye te lama te timplu ne diye dapit te igsile. 5 Ne migkahiyan din sikandan, “Pammineg kew keddi, me Libita! Linisi niyu ka pegkeetew niyu wey ka timplu te Magbebaye, ka Manama te me kaap-apuan niyu. Awaa niyu ka langun ne malindit diye te timplu. 6 Su warad migmatinumanen ka me kaapuan ta. Mareet ka hinimuwan dan diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye wey in-engkeran dan sikandin. In-engkeran dan ka timplu te Magbebaye wey mig-inniyuhan dan sikandin. 7 Impanlekeban dan ka me gumawan diye te likansu te timplu wey impangebukan dan ka me sulu. Warad e sikandan migtutung te insinsu wey ke migpanubad naa te igpanubad ne egtutungen diye te matulus ne inged te Manama te Israil. 8 Purisu, nalangetan ka Magbebaye te keet-etawan te Huda wey te Hirusalim. Ne indusaan din sikandan te amana ne makaliyasliyas, egpakataneng, wey egpakabenga-benga te me etew. Nanengnengan niyud seini amana. 9 Tenged kayi, migpangimatayan ka me kaapuan ta wey impandakep ka me anak ta, wey ka me asawa ta.

3 On the first month on the first year of his kinging, he caused_ the temple of the Lord _to_be_opened and he repaired it. 4 He gathered the sacrificers and the Libitas there in the courtyard of the temple there in east side. 5 And he told them, “Listen(pl) to me, Libitas! Clean(pl) yourselves and the temple of the Lord, the God of your(pl) ancestors. Remove(pl) all the dirty in the temple. 6 Because our(incl) ancestors were not obedient anymore. Their doings were bad there in front of the Lord and they abandoned him. They have abandoned the temple of the Lord and they turned_back_on_it. 7 They have closed the doorway of the porch of the temple and they put_out the lamps. They stopped burning incense or sacrifice burnt offering in the holy place of God of Israil. 8 Therefore, the Lord was angry at the people of Huda and of Hirusalim. And he punished them with terrifying, shocking, and stunned the people. You(pl) knew this well already. 9 Due to this, our(incl) ancestors were_killed and our(incl) children were captured, and our(incl) wives.

10 “Ne kuntee, eggimu a te kasabutan te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil eyew egkaawe ka migpangebel-ebel ne langet din kanta. 11 Me anak ku, kene kew e lengkay-lengkay, in-alam kew te Magbebaye eyew egsasindeg diye te tangkaan din, eyew egpamakey, eyew egkeyimu ne suluhuanen din, wey eyew te pegtutung te insinsu para kandin.”

10 “And now/today, I will_make an agreement with the Lord, the God of Israil in_order that his smoking anger to us(incl) will_be_gone. 11 My children, don't(pl) be reckless, the Lord has chosen you(pl) in_order to stand in front of him, in_order to serve, in_order to become his servants, and in_order for burning the incense for him.”

12-14 Seini ka me Libita ne migbunsud e migtrabahu te sikan de:

12-14 These were the Libitas who started working right_away:

Si Mahat ne anak ni Amasiyas wey si Huwil ne anak ni Asariyas ne egpuun te kabuhalan ni Kuhat.

15 Inlibulung dan ka me duma ran ne Libita wey immatulus dan ka pegkeetew ran. Ne miggendiye sikandan te timplu eyew te peglinis kayi. They obeyed the command of the king according to the word of the Lord. 16 The sacrificers entered the temple in_order for cleaning it. They brought_outside to the yard the dirty utensils that_ they _saw inside. And that was_taken(pl) by the Libitas and brought there to the plain(s) of Kidrun.

17 Ne migbunsud sikandan migpanlinis te timplu te an-anayan ne aldew te an-anayan ne bulan. Ne te igkawalu ne aldew, neumaan dan e ka likansu te timplu. Te lein e man-e ne walu ne aldew, nalinisan dan e ka timplu. Purisu neimpusan dan ka langun ne himu te igkasapulu wey hen-em (16) ne aldew te seeye ded ne bulan.

17 And they began to_clean the temple on the first day of the first month. And on the eighth day, they arrived_at the porch of the temple. On another again eight days, they made_ the temple _clean. Therefore they finished all the work on the sixteenth (16) day of just that month.

18 Ne miggendiye sikandan ki Hari Isikiyas wey migkahi, “Nalinisan ney e ka intiru ne timplu te Magbebaye, ka altar ne tutunganan te igpanubad wey ka langun ne me kasangkapan kayi, ka lamisa ne eg-unturan te paan ne igpanubad wey ka langun ne me kasangkapan. 19 Nalinisan ney e man-e wey naandam e ka langun ne kasangkapan ne indegpak ni Hari Ahas te me timpu ne warad sikandin migmatinumanen te Manama. Diyad e seini kuntee te tangkaan te altar te Magbebaye wey egkaayun e ne eggamiten.”

18 And they went_there to King Isikiyas and said, “We(excl) have_cleaned the entire temple of the Lord, the altar that's a burning_place for sacrifices and all the equipments for_it, the table that's a putting_place for bread that's sacrificed and all the utensils for_it. 19 We(excl) also cleaned and prepared all the utensils that were_thrown_out by King Ahas at the time that he wasn't being_faithful to God. These (are) there now in front of the altar of the Lord and allowable already to use.”

20 Ne migselem-selem mig-enew si Hari Isikiyas wey inlibulung din ka me upisyal te siyudad, wey miggendiye sikandan te timplu te Magbebaye. 21 Ne migmanguyan sikandan te pitu ne turu ne me baka, pitu ne turu ne me karniru, pitu ne nati ne karniru, wey pitu ne turu ne kambing ne igpanubad eyew te peglinis te migharian, te timplu, wey te Huda. Ne insuhu ni Hari Isikiyas ka me talagpanubad ne kabuhalan ni Aarun ne igpanubad seeye diye te altar te Magbebaye. 22 Purisu inggimatayan te me talagpanubad ka me turu ne baka wey insawig dan ka langesa kayi diye te altar. Ne inggimatayan dan e man-e ka me turu ne karniru wey insawig dan e man-e ka langesa kayi diye te altar. Ne inggimatayan dan e man-e ka me nati ne karniru wey insawig dan e man-e ka langesa kayi diye te altar. 23 Ne ka me turu ne kambing ne igpanubad eyew te peglinis te sale, in-uyan dan diye te Hari wey diye te me etew, wey intel-eb dan ka me belad dan kayi. 24 Ne inggimatayan te me talagpanubad ka me kambing wey in-ule dan ka langesa kayi diye te altar eyew igpalangesa eyew te peglinis te sale te langun ne matig-Israil. Su migsuhu ma ka Hari ne para te langun ne matig-Israil seeye se egtutungen ne igpanubad wey ka igpanubad ne para te sale.

20 And King Isikiyas rose early and he gathered the officials of the city, and they went_there to the temple of the Lord. 21 And they brought(pl) seven bull cows, seven ram sheep, seven sheep lambs, and seven male goats to_sacrifice in_order for cleaning the kingdom, the temple, and Huda. And King Isikiyas commanded the sacrificers that (were) descendant(s) of Aarun to_sacrifice these there on the altar of the Lord. 22 Therefore the sacrificers killed the bull cows and they sprinkled the blood of_them there on the altar. And they also killed the ram sheep and they also sprinkled the blood of_them there on the altar. And they also killed the sheep lambs and they also sprinkled the blood of_them there on the altar. 23 And the male goats that were_to_be_sacrificed in_order for cleaning of sin, were_brought by_them there to the king and to the people, and they laid their hands/arms on_them. 24 And the sacrificers killed the goats and they poured the blood of_them there on the altar in_order to_spill_blood in_order for cleaning the sin of all from_Israil. Because the king commanded that those burnt sacrifices and the sacrifice for sin (were) for all the (ones) from_Israil.

25 Ne inteil ni Isikiyas ka me Libita diye te timplu te Magbebaye ne mig-uyan te me putew ne basalan, alpa, wey me lira. Te egbunsuran e ka pegtutung, imbunsuran e degma ka peg-ulahing para te Magbebaye wey imparahing ka me trumpita, wey duma pad ne me instrumintu ni Dabid ne Hari dengan te Israil. 28 Migsimba ka langun ne keet-etawan wey mig-ulahing ka me mangngulahing, wey migparahing ka me talagparahing te trumpita. Migpabulus ka peg-ulahing wey ka pegparahing te trumpita taman te neimpusan e ka pegtutung te igpanubad. 29 Te neimpusan e ka pegtutung te igmanubad, migpanimbuel e si Hari Isikiyas wey ka langun ne duma rin wey migsimba te Magbebaye. 30 Ne insuhu ni Hari Isikiyas wey te me upisyal rin ka me Libita ne eg-ulahing te pegdayan te Magbebaye pinaahi te ulahingen ne insulat ni Hari Dabid wey ni Asap ne etew te Manama. Mig-ulahing sikandan te pegdayan ne nahale, migpanimbuel, wey migsimba.

25 And Isikiyas arranged the Libitas there at the temple of the Lord that brought steel gongs, harp(s), and lyres. He obeyed all the commands of the Lord that were_given before to King Dabid by_means of Gad the person of God and by prophet Natan. 26 And the Libitas that brought the instruments of King Dabid before and the sacrificers that brought trumpets stood. 27 And Isikiyas commanded that the sacrifices be_burned there on the altar. When the burning began, the singing for the Lord and the sounding of trumpets, and yet other instruments of Dabid the king of Israil long_ago also began. 28 All the people worshiped and the singers sang, and the sounders of trumpet(s) sounded. The singing and the sounding of trumpet(s) continued until the burning of the sacrifices finished. 29 When the burning of the sacrifices was_finished, King Isikiyas and all his companions kneeled and worshiped the Lord. 30 And King Isikiyas and his officials commanded the Libitas to_sing for praising the Lord by_means of the song(s) that was_written by King Dabid and by Asap the person of God. They sang for praising that's happy, kneeled, and worshiped.

31 Ne migkahi si Isikiyas, “Kuntee te inhalad niyud ma ka pegkeetew niyu diye te Magbebaye, hendini kew wey uyan kew te igmanubad niyu wey te ighalad para te pegpasalamat diye te timplu te Magbebaye.” Purisu migpanguyan ka keet-etawan te igmanubad wey te igpanubad para te pegpasalamat wey mig-uyan degma te igpanubad ne egtutungen seeye se langun ne egkeupian ne egpanubad.

31 And Isikiyas said, “Now/Today that you(pl) have_offered your(pl) selves there to the Lord, come_here(pl) and bring(pl) your(pl) sacrifices and the offering for giving_thanks there to the temple of the Lord.” Therefore the people brought(pl) the sacrifices and the offering for giving_thanks and all those that wanted to_sacrifice also brought the sacrifice to_be_burned.

32 Ka langun ne igmanubad ne egtutungen ne in-uyan te keet-etawan, migginguma te pitu ne pulu (70) ka turu ne baka, sabeka ne gatus (100) ka turu ne karniru, wey daruwa ne gatus (200) ka nati ne karniru. And that all, was_sacrificed by_burning for the Lord. 33 And they also brought other sacrifices six hundred (600) bull cows and three thousand (3,000) sheep and goats. 34 But the sacrificers to_cut_the_throat of the domestic_animals that were_sacrificed by_burning (were) just few (LIT small), therefore their relative Libitas helped until they finished the work, and until the other sacrificers had_cleaned them selves. Because the Libitas (were) more faithful in cleaning their selves than the sacrificers. 35 Besides the very_many sacrifices to_be_burned, there_was also still fat of domestic_animals that were_gifted for peace/prosperity, and offerings of drink along_with sacrifices that were_burned.

Purisu, nakalibed ka pegpamakey ran te Magbebaye diye te timplu.36 Ne si Isikiyas wey ka keet-etawan, nahale-gale tenged su imbulihan sikandan te Manama ne mahaan egkeimpusi ka himu.

Ka pegpangandam te pegsahakeen

The preparing for feasting

301 Ne impanengneng ni Hari Isikiyas ka intiru ne Israil wey Huda, wey insulatan din degma ka me kabuhalan ni Ipraim wey ni Manasis ne keilangan ne eggendiye sikandan te timplu te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te Hirusalim eyew egsahakeen te Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan te Magbebaye, ne Manama te Israil. 2 [xr]Su ka Hari wey ka me upisyal rin, wey ka langun ne keet-etawan te Hirusalim, nekeg-uyun ne egsahakeen te Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan te igkarangeb ne bulan. 3 Su ware ma nekeyimu sikandan te Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan te an-anayan ne bulan ne iyan ka timpu te pegsahakeen, tenged su ware pad nakalinis ka me talagpanubad te pegkeetew ran, wey ware pad nalibulung ka keet-etawan te Hirusalim. 4 Ne ingkeupii te Hari wey te langun ne keet-etawan ka seeye ne planu. 5 Purisu, impanengneng dan ka intiru ne Israil, puun te Birsiba peendiye te Dan, ne keilangan ne eggendiye sikandan te Hirusalim eyew eggimu te Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil. Te miglihad ne me sahakeen, pila-pila re ka migmanambung, piru kahi te balaud ne keilangan ne egtambung ka langun. 6 Ne impandulung te me talagdulung diye te intiru ne Israil wey te Huda ka me sulat ne egpuun te Hari wey te me upisyal rin. Seini ka tahu te sulat: “Sikaniyu se me matig-Israil ne nakapallahuy puun te me Hari te Asirya, libed kew e te Magbebaye, ne Manama ni Abraham, ni Isaak wey ni Hakub,[fn] eyew eglibed sikandin kaniyu. 7 Kene niyu ilingi ka me kaap-apuan niyu wey ka me suled niyu ne ware migmatinumanen te Magbebaye ne Manama ran, sikan naa ka imparereetan din sikandan sumale te nakita niyu kuntee. 8 Kene niyu pakehala ka me ulu niyu iling te me kabuybuyahan niyu, peiluk-iluk kew te Magbebaye. Hendiye kew te timplu te Magbebaye ne immatulus din te ware egtamanan. Pamakey kew kandin eyew egkaawe ka migpangebel-ebel ne langet din kaniyu. 9 Su ke eglibed kew te Magbebaye, ka karumaan niyu wey ka me anak niyu ne naddakep, igkeyid-u te nakarakep kandan wey igpalibed sikandan te seini ne tane. Su hiid-uwen wey hiimenawen sikandin wey kene sikandin eg-engked kaniyu ke eglibed kew kandin.”

301 Then King Isikiyas informed the entire Israil and Huda, and he also wrote_to the descendants of Ipraim and of Manasis that it's_necessary that they go_there to the temple of the Lord God there in Hirusalim in_order to_feast the Feast of the Passing_by of the Angel of the Lord, that's God of Israil. 2 [xr]Because the king and his officials, and all the people of Hirusalim, agreed to celebrate Feast of the Passing_by of the Angel on the second month. 3 Because they were not able to celebrate (LIT make) Feast of the Passing_by of the Angel on the first month that's the time of the celebration, because the sacrificers were not yet able to clean themselves, and the people of Hirusalim were not yet gathered around. 4 And the king and all people were pleased by that plan. 5 Therefore, they informed(pl) the entire Israil, from Birsiba there_to Dan, and they needed(pl) to go to Hirusalim in_order to_do the Feast of the Passing_by of the Angel of the Lord, the God of Israil. On the previous feasts, only very_few had_attended, but the law said that it's_necessary that all attend. 6 And the carriers carried(pl) there to the entire Israil and Huda the letters that's from the king and his officials. This is the content of the letter: “You(pl) from_Israil who were_able_to_run_away from the kings of Asirya, return_back(pl) to the Lord, God of Abraham, Isaak and Hakub,[fn] so that he will return to_you(pl). 7 Do(pl)_ not _follow/imitate your(pl) ancestors and your(pl) relatives (who) were not faithful(pl) to the Lord their God, that's why he caused_ them _to_be_destroyed according to what you(pl) see now/today. 8 Do not be_stubborn (LIT make(pl) your(pl) heads hard) like your(pl) elders, surrender(pl) to the Lord. Go_there(pl) to the temple of the Lord which he made_holy without ending. Worship(pl) him so_that his smoking_anger to you(pl) will_be_gone. 9 Because if you(pl) return_back(pl) to the Lord, your(pl) captured relatives and your(pl) children, will_be_pitied by those (who) captured them and they'll be_caused_to_return to this land. Because he is merciful and compassionate and he won't leave you(pl) (behind) if you(pl) return_back to him.”

10 Purisu immangendiyaan te me talagdulung te sulat ka me siyudad te intiru ne Ipraim wey Manasis taman te Sabulun piru migngingisiyan de iya sikandan wey miglelemetan. 11 Piru duen ded me etew ne egpuun te Asir, Manasis wey Sabulun ne migpariralem te pegkeetew ran ne migmangendiye te Hirusalim. 12 Ne insabeka te Manama ka langun ne matig-Huda pinaahi te pegtuman te suhu ni Hari Isikiyas wey te me upisyal rin. Ka seeye ne suhu, egpuun ded te Magbebaye.

10 Therefore the carriers of the letters went to the entire cities of Ipraim and Manasis until Sabulun but they were just only laughed at and mocked. 11 But there (were) people that's coming_from Asir, Manasis and Sabulun who humbled themselves and went(pl) to Hirusalim. 12 And God caused_to_be_united all the (ones) from_Huda by_means of obeying the command of king Isikiyas and his officials. That command, (was) still from the Lord.

Ka pegsahakeen

The celebration

13 Purisu te igkarangeb ne bulan, masulug ne me etew ka migmangendiye te Hirusalim eyew te peggimu te Sahakeen te Paan ne Ware Patulin. 14 Ne migbunsud sikandan pinaahi te pegpangawe te me altar te me diyus-diyus diye te Hirusalim lagkes seeye se me altar ne tutunganan te insinsu, wey immandegpak dan diye te Napu te Kidrun. 15 Te igkasapulu wey hep-at (14) ne aldew te igkarangeb ne bulan, immanggilang e mule te keet-etawan ka me nati ne karniru ne para te Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan wey neneyilew e ka me talagpanubad wey ka me Libita. Sikan naa ka nakalinis sikandan te pegkeetew ran wey egkaayun e sikandan ne egpanubad te egtutungen ne igpanubad diye te timplu. 16 Ne migsasindeg sikandan diye te egsasasindehan dan sumale te balaud ni Muwisis ne suluhuanen te Manama. Ne insawig te me talagpanubad diye te altar ka langesa ne indulung te me Libita. 17 Tenged te masulug ka me etew ne ware nakalinis te pegkeetew ran, ka me Libite e ka miggilang te me karniru ne para te Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan para te seeye se ware nakalinis te pegkeetew eyew egkeyimu sikandan ne malinis. Ne inlinisan te me Libita ka me nati ne karniru para te Magbebaye. 18 Ne masulug ka miggendiye ne me matig-Ipraim, me matig-Manasis, me matig-Isakar wey me matig-Sabulun ne ware nakalinis te pegkeetew ran. Piru nakakeen ded sikandan te impanubad ne para te Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan minsan ke supak te balaud, su mig-ampu ma si Hari Isikiyas para kandan. Migkahi sikandin, “Magbebaye, pasaylua nu ka tagse sabeka ne etew 19 ne nakasakat ne egpangananey te intiru ne pusung dan keykew te Manama te me kabuybuyahan dan minsan pad ke kene ne malinis sikandan sumale te balaud te timplu.” 20 Ne narineg te Magbebaye si Isikiyas wey impasaylu[fn] rin sikandan. 21 Migsahakeen te Paan ne Ware Patulin te pitu ne aldew ka me matig-Israil ne diye te Hirusalim, duma te dakel ne kahale. Tagse aldew, migdayan te Magbebaye ka me Libita wey ka me talagpanubad. Egkahale-gale sikandan ka egmangulahing diye te Magbebaye duma te meemen amana ne me instrumintu. 22 Ne indayan ni Hari Isikiyas ka me Libita tenged te impakita ran ne katuenan te pegpamakey te Magbebaye. Purisu, migpabulus ka pegsahakeen te pitu ne aldew. Migpanubad sikandan te me dasag para te keupianan wey migpasalamat sikandan diye te Magbebaye, ka Manama te me kaap-apuan dan.

13 That's why on the second month, plenty people went(pl) to Hirusalim in_order to fulfill (LIT obey) the Feast of the Bread with No Rising_agent. 14 And they started(pl) by_means of removing(pl) altars of the false_gods there in Hirusalim including those altars for burning incense, and they threw(pl) (them) there in the Plain of Kidrun. 15 On the fourteenth (14) day of the second month, people have_slaughtered(pl) the young sheeps for the Feast of the Passing_by of the Angel and that made_ the sacrificers and the Libita _ashamed. That's why they made_ their selves _clean and it's_ now _possible that they may sacrifice burned offering there in the temple. 16 And they stood up there on their standing_places according to the law of Muwisis the servant of God. And sacrificers splashed the blood which was_brought_in by the Libitas to the altar. 17 Because there (were) many people who (were) not_able to clean themselves, the Libitas (were) the (ones) who killed the sheeps for the Feast of the Passing_by of the Angel for those who were not able to clean them_selves so that they will_become clean. And the young sheeps was cleaned by the Libitas for the Lord. 18 And many of the (ones) from_Ipraim went there, from_Manasis, from_Isakar and form_Sabulun who (were) not_able to clean themselves. But they were_able to eat offerings for Feast of the Passing_by of the Angel even if against the law, because king Isikiyas prayed for them. He said, “Lord, forgive each person 19 who decided to seek_help(pl) to you(sg) God of their elders with their entire heart even if they're not clean according to the law of the temple.” 20 And the Lord heard(pl) Isikiyas and he forgave[fn] them. 21 The (ones) from_Israil celebrated the Bread with No Rising_agent for seven days there in Hirusalim, along_with great gladness. Each day, the Libitas and the sacrificers praised the Lord. They were very happy singing to the Lord along_with very loud(pl) instruments. 22 And King Isikiyas praised the Libitas because of the knowledge they showed in worshiping the Lord. Therefore, the celebration continued for seven days. They sacrificed gifts for peace and they gave(pl) thanks to the Lord, God of their ancestors.

The celebration (was) extended

23 Ne nekegsabut ka keet-etawan ne egsumpulan dan ka sahakeen te lein pad ne pitu ne aldew. Ne masulug pad ka me talagpanubad ne miglinis te pegkeetew ran. 25 Miggale-gale ka langun ne keet-etawan te Huda wey ka me talagpanubad, me Libita, wey ka langun ne egpuun te Israil, wey ka me lapu ne egpuun te Israil wey te Huda. 26 Purisu, due kahalaan diye te Hirusalim, su te timpu te anak ni Dabid ne si Sulumun ne Hari te Israil, ware ma neyitabu ne iling dutu. 27 Ne migsasindeg ka me talagpanubad wey me Libita eyew egpanalangin te keet-etawan. Ne narineg sikandan te Manama, su ka peg-ampu dan nekeuma ma te langit, ka matulus ne ugpaan din.

23 And the people agreed_each_other that they extend the celebration for another seven days. Therefore they celebrated again for another seven days very_happy. 24 And Isikiyas king of Huda, gave(sg) one thousand (1,000) bull cows and seven thousand (7,000) sheeps and goats to the people. And the officials also gave(pl) one thousand (1,000) bull cows and ten thousand (10,000) sheeps and goats. 4 [xr]Ne insuhu din man-e ka matig-Israil ne igbehey ka baad te me talagpanubad wey te me Libita puun te impanubad eyew ware lein ne eggimuwen dan ke kene ka pegtuman naan de te Balaud te Magbebaye. 5 Te ingkapanengneng e seini diye te me etew, nahale-gale ne migbehey ka me matig-Israil te langun ne igkasapulu dan lagkes ka tetelesi te trigu ran, te binu, te lana, te teneb wey duma pad ne egkahaani ran diye te kamet. 4 [xr]And he commanded again the (ones) from_Hirusalim to give the portion to the sacrificers and to the Libitas from the sacrifice so that they don't work any longer but instead just follow the Law of the Lord. 5 When this was_announced to the people, the (ones) from_Israil (were) very_happy in giving their tenths including their very_good wheat, wine, oil, honey and some more (that) they could_harvest from their farm. Mareet ka hinimuwan din diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama rin. 6 [xr]Nataman, inlusuran sikandin ni Nibukadnisar ne Hari te Babilunya, wey imbaku sikandin te keddina. Ne in-uyan e sikandin diye te Babilunya. 7 In-uyan degma ni Nibukadnisar diye te Babilunya ka duma ne me kasangkapan te timplu te Magbebaye wey intahu diye te palasyu rin.

5 [xr]Huwakim (was) twenty-five (25) years old when he became king, and the kinged there in Hirusalim for eleven (11) years. His actions (were) evil/bad there in the front of the Lord his God. 6 [xr]Afterwards, he (was) invaded by Nibukadnisar the king of Babilunya, and he was_bound with chain. And he was_taken there to Babilunya. 7 Other possessions of the temple of the Lord were_ also _taken to Babilunya by Nibukadnisar and put there in his palace.

8 Ka duma pad ne guhuren te peghari ni Huwakim wey ka mallindit ne immangimu rin, nasulat diye te Sulatanan te me Guhuren te me Hari te Israil wey te Huda. Ne si Huwakin e ne anak din ka migsubal kandin mighari.

8 The rest of the stories concerning the kinging by Huwakim and his evil/dirty actions, were_written on the writting_document of the stories of the kings of Israil and Huda. And Huwakin his child replaced him in kinging.

Ka peghari ni Huwakin te Huda

The kinging of Huda by Huwakin

(2 Hari 24:8‑17)

(2 Kings 24:8‑17)

9 Sapulu wey walu (18) ka idad ni Huwakin te neyimu sikandin ne Hari, wey mighari sikandin diye te Hirusalim te tatelu re ne bulan wey sapulu (10) ne aldew. Mareet ka hinimuwan din diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye. 10 [xra][xrb]Te an-anayan ne bulan te seeye ne leg-un, impaangey ni Nibukadnisar sikandin wey impeendiye te Babilunya lagkes ka mahal ne me kasangkapan te timplu te Magbebaye. Ne ka suled din ne si Sidikiyas, iyan e impahari ni Nibukadnisar te Huda wey te Hirusalim.

9 Huwakin (was) eighteen (18) years old when he became king, and he kinged there in Hirusalim for three months only and ten (10) days. His actions (were) evil/bad there in the front of the Lord. 10 [xra][xrb]In the first month of that year, Nibukadnisar sent for him and was_caused_to_go_there to Babilunya along with the expensive possessions of the temple of the Lord. And Sidikiyas his brother/cousin, was_made_to_rule in Huda and Hirusalim by Nibukadnisar.

Ka peghari ni Sidikiyas te Huda

The kinging of Huda by Sidikiyas

(2 Hari 24:18‑20; Hir 52:1‑3a)

(2 Kings 24:18‑20; Jer 52:1‑3a)

11 [xr]Daruwa ne pulu wey sabeka (21) ka idad ni Sidikiyas te neyimu sikandin ne Hari, wey mighari sikandin diye te Hirusalim te sapulu wey sabeka (11) ne leg-un. 12 Ne mareet ka hinimuwan din diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama rin. Ware sikandin migpariralem ki prupita Hirimiyas ne miglalag te lalag te Manama. 13 [xr]Migribildi man-e sikandin ki Hari Nibukadnisar minsan ke migpahunlibet sikandin te ngaran te Manama ne egmatinumanen ki Nibukadnisar. Makehal ka ulu ni Sidikiya wey ware iya sikandin miglibed te Magbebaye, ka Manama te Israil. 14 Ne suble e degma ne mareet ka langun ne pangulu te me talagpanubad wey ka keet-etawan te Huda. Mig-ikul sikandan te mallindit ne hinimuwan te lein ne me nasud wey inlinditan dan ka timplu ne immatulus te Magbebaye diye te Hirusalim.

11 [xr]Sidikiyas was twenty one (21) years old when he became king, and he kinged there in Hirusalim for eleven (11) years. 12 His actions (were) evil/bad there in the front of the Lord his God. He didn't humble_himself to prophet Hirimiyas who spoke of the word of God. 13 [xr]He rebelled also against king Nibukadnisar even if he promised in the name of God that he'd be_faithful to Nibukadnisar. The head of Sidikiya (was) hard indeed and he didn't return to the Lord, the God of Israil. 14 And all leader of the Sacrificers (were) also very evil/bad already and the people of Huda. They followed the evil/dirty actions of other nations and they dirtied the temple that's made_holy by the Lord there in Hirusalim.

15 Layun egpaney-paney kandan ka Magbebaye, ka Manama te me kaap-apuan dan pinaahi te me insuhu din ne egpahuhuren din su egkeyid-u ma sikandin kandan wey te timplu rin. 16 Piru inlelemetan dan de iya ka immanuhu ne egpahuhuren te Manama, ware dan linglingaa ka me lalag din, wey inderali-dian dan de ka me prupita rin. Purisu nalangetan kandan ka Magbebaye wey ware nakapegnel te langet din. 17 [xr]Purisu impalusuran te Magbebaye sikandan te me matig-Babilunya. Impeyimatayan din e te ware pegkeyid-u ka me kanakan diye te timplu lagkes ka me mengebay ne ware pad neyilabeti, wey ka me buyag-buyag e minsan seeye se me buyag e amana. Imbehey sikandan langun te Manama ki Nibukadnisar. 18 Ne ka langun ne kasangkapan te timplu te Manama, dakel ma wey se deisek, ka me karatuan te timplu, ka karatuan te Hari wey ka karatuan te me upisyal rin, impanguyan langun ni Nibukadnisar diye te Babilunya. 19 [xr]Ne insilaban dan ka timplu te Manama wey impandereetan dan ka matikang wey makepal ne alad ne batu te Hirusalim. Impanilaban dan degma ka intiru ne palasyu wey impandereetan dan ka mahal ne me kasangkapan diye. 20 Ne naddakep ni Hari Nibukadnisar ka langun ne ware migpatey wey nanguyan din e diye te Babilunya, wey inggimu rin sikandan ne me uripen din wey te me kabuhalan din taman te natalu e te migharian te Pirsya ka Babilunya. 21 [xr]Purisu, natuman ka lalag te Magbebaye pinaahi ki prupita Hirimiyas ne egkeyimu ne ware eetawen te Huda wey egkeengkeran seini te pitu (70) ne pulu ne leg-un.

15 They always reminded by their Lord, the God of their ancestors by_means of those he sent to_tell because he felt_pity to them and to his temple. 16 But they just mocked those God sent to_tell, they did not pay_attention to his words, and they just jeered_at his prophets. That's why God got_angry at them and no (one) was_able_to_control his anger. 17 [xr]Therefore the Lord caused_ them _to_be_invaded by the (ones) from_Babilunya. (He) had_ the young_males who (were) in the temple _killed without mercy including the young_females who (were) still virgin (LIT not intercourse_with), and the old (ones) even those who are very old (ones). They (were) all given by God to Nibukadnisar. 18 And all the possessions of the temple of God, whether big or small, the riches of the temple, the riches of the king and the riches of his officials, (were) all taken to Babilunya by Nibukadnisar. 19 [xr]And they burned the temple of God and they destroyed the high and thick stone fence of Hirusalim. They also burned the entire palace and they destroyed the expensive possessions there. 20 And all those who survived were_captured by king Nibukadnisar and taken to Babilunya, and they were_made slaves by him and by his descendants until kingdom of Pirsya defeated Babilunya. 21 [xr]Therefore, the word of the Lord by_means of prophet Hirimiyas fulfilled that the Huda will_become no people_at_all and it will_be_left_behind for seventy (70) years.

Ka pegpeuli ni Sirus te me matig-Huda

The being_sent_home by Sirus of the (ones) from_Huda

(Isra 1:1‑4)

(Ezra 1:1‑4)

22 Ne te an-anayan ne leg-un te peghari ni Sirus te Pirsya, intuman te Magbebaye ka lalag din pinaahi ki Hirimiyas. Impuwasan te Magbebaye ka suman-suman ni Sirus eyew egpakasulat te sabeka ne pegpataha te intiru ne migharian din.

22 And in the first year of kinging in Pirsya by Sirus, God fulfilled his word by_means of Hirimiyas. God opened Sirus thinking in_order that he can_write an announcement for his entire kingdom.

23 [xr]Seini ka insulat ni Hari Sirus te Pirsya: “Ka Magbebaye ne iyan ka Manama ne diye te langit, ka migbehey keddi te langun ne migharian kayi te kalibutan. In-alam a nikandin ne egbalew-balew egpasasindeg te timplu para kandin diye te Hirusalim ne sakup te Huda. Sikaniyu se langun ne keet-etawan te Manama, egkaayun e ne egpakalibed diye te tane niyu. Ne egdumaan kew te Magbebaye ne Manama.”

23 [xr]This is what king Sirus wrote for Pirsya: “The Lord that's God there in heaven, (is the one) who gave me all kingdoms here on earth. He chose me to rebuild again the temple for him there in Hirusalim under_the_jurisdiction of Huda. All of you(pl) people of God, it's_possible to_return there to your(pl) land. And you(pl) be_accompanied by the Lord God.”
